_help: Windows-only: winxmerge here is a personal cargo-built binary, not a public tool — replace <WINXMERGE_PATH> with wherever your own copy actually lives (or swap "cmd" for any other diff/merge tool entirely). There's no direct Linux/macOS equivalent bundled alongside this one since the tool itself doesn't exist there; a cross-platform GUI merge tool like meld or kdiff3 slots into the same "context": "compare" + %LEFT%/%RIGHT% shape if you want one. Compare-mode launcher: Enter on a file that exists on both sides opens it in the configured tool. %LEFT%/%RIGHT% are the left/right pane files. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
name: Merge in WinXMerge
